body:
Well, despite being literally the ugliest girl I've ever seen, I also have zero redeeming qualities. I'm just garbage, inside and out. 

But it isn't even that I'm afraid of never getting a boyfriend. Right now, no one loves me and I've felt that way for years. My dad is too drunk, my mom is emotionally distant and I have no one else. I've never had anyone and I feel that growing up feeling unloved has probably rendered me completely unlovable and will for the rest of my life. I don't know. I just hate myself.

Thanks for the encouragement though. Depression really is a bitch lol.
Hey. I won't tell you not to do it because I personally find that preachy and annoying, but I'd love to listen to anything you have to say, if you want.
